question: Do Delta line-number format prefixes and suffixes undercount terminal columns when one grapheme occupies more than one display column, causing side-by-side content width to be over-budgeted?

sources.name: dandavison/delta
sources.claim: Line-number format metadata stores prefix_len and suffix_len as grapheme counts; formatted_width feeds side-by-side available_line_width.

command: GitHub Actions: Fieldwork Delta wide line-number format probe

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: A wide literal prefix is budgeted by its real terminal width.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: The suspected undercount is absent; retain a negative result.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: A one-grapheme/two-column prefix contributes one metadata column, and available_line_width receives one extra content column compared with actual rendered width.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: The line-number width owner has a target-executed column-accounting mismatch.

stop_condition: Stop after exact target tests classify wide-prefix metadata and the derived side-by-side budget; require a rendered-output discriminator before source promotion.
network_policy: Read-only fetch of the exact public Delta revision during owned Fieldwork CI; no third-party mutation.
